capabilities: Launch external applications from a ribbon icon
Configure apps by name with a desktop file path
Open mobile apps via URL schemes such as notion:// or bear://
Run iOS shortcuts through a URL scheme
extras: Manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff; the README is bilingual (English and Chinese) and only shows settings examples, not screenshots.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to start external applications or automations, so users must switch away manually to run sync tools or companion apps.

relations.evidence: Launch auxiliary tools like Zotero or other note-taking apps during your creative process

requires.name: the applications to launch (e.g. sync tools, Notion, Bear, Zotero)

summary: Ribbon-based launcher that opens configured desktop apps by file path or mobile apps and shortcuts by URL scheme.
